column.name: target_type
column.Comment: 被审核对象类型: GOODS / SKU / OTHER

column.name: status
column.Comment: 审核状态: 待审核, 通过, 拒绝, 已撤销

column.name: extra_info
column.Comment: 扩展信息: 可存储SKU组合/商品规格等JSON

column.name: display_images
column.Comment: 商品展示图(第一张为主图)

column.name: order_item_id
column.Comment: 订单明细ID（唯一，一次购买一次评价）

column.name: sku_spec_snapshot
column.Comment: SKU规格快照，如：颜色:红 / 内存:512G

column.name: name
column.Comment: 单位名称，如 件/个/瓶

column.name: sku_specs
column.Comment: SKU规格快照，如：颜色=黑色;尺码=L

column.name: comment_status
column.Comment: 评论状态：0-未评价 1-已评价

column.name: order_type
column.Comment: 订单类型：PARENT-父订单, SUB-子订单, NORMAL-普通订单（单店铺）

column.name: reason
column.Comment: 订单取消或关闭原因（用于CANCELED/CLOSED状态）

column.name: type
column.Comment: 资源类型: menu, catalog, button

column.name: built_in
column.Comment: 是否为内置角色(不可删除)

column.name: name
column.Comment: 规格名，如 颜色、尺码

column.name: banner
column.Comment: 店铺顶部横幅背景图 URL
